messages.content: "Could you please help me find the price of the artwork named 'Starry Night' by the artist 'Vincent Van Gogh' on the 'Sotheby' auction platform, and then fetch the price of another artwork called 'The Scream' by 'Edvard Munch' on the 'Christie' platform? After that, I would like to search for a book titled 'To Kill a Mockingbird' by the author 'Harper Lee' in the 'New York Public Library', and then look for another book named '1984' by 'George Orwell' in the 'British Library'."

function.name: library_search_book
function.description: Search for a specific book in the library. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

title.description: The title of the book to be searched.

author.description: The author of the book to ensure the precise book is fetched.

platform.description: The library where the book should be fetched from.

function.name: art_auction_fetch_artwork_price
function.description: Fetch the price of a specific artwork on the auction platform. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artwork_name.description: The name of the artwork to be searched.

artist.description: The artist's name to ensure the precise artwork is fetched.

platform.description: The platform where the artwork's price should be fetched from.

message.reasoning:
We need to call two art auctions first, then two books.

First art auction: Starry Night by Vincent Van Gogh on Sotheby. Use art_auction_fetch_artwork_price with parameters: artwork_name="Starry Night", artist="Vincent Van Gogh", platform="Sotheby".

Second art auction: The Scream by Edvard Munch on Christie. Use same function but platform="Christie". Wait we have only one tool defined: art_auction_fetch_artwork_price. That can handle different platforms; yes it has optional param platform. So second call uses platform="Christie".

Then book searches:

library_search_book for To Kill a Mockingbird by Harper Lee at New York Public Library (NYPL). Provide platform= "New York Public Library"? Actually parameter platform refers to library location or system. We'll set platform="New York Public Library".

Next library_search_book for 1984 by George Orwell at British Library. Set platform="British Library".

Thus four calls sequentially. We will produce JSON array as per instructions. Let's do each call separately using the function.
